slides.title: Hospitals strained as fighting resumed
slides.body: What MSF reported from northern Ethiopia

slides.title: War-wounded at Korem and Alamata
slides.body: Patients rose from about 180 to over 420 between Sept. 22 and 25, MSF said.

slides.title: War-wounded at Suhul hospital, Shire
slides.body: Arrived by Sept. 25, according to MSF.

slides.title: Alamata hospital activities suspended
slides.body: MSF said insecurity also halted its outreach work; staff were redirected to hospitals.

slides.title: Care continues in Shire, Sheraro and Korem
slides.body: MSF supports these hospitals, including maternal and child health care, and is preparing for displaced people.

slides.title: Protect health workers and patients. Keep care and aid open.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: MSF, "MSF teams scale up medical response as fighting resumes in Ethiopia" · Sept 28, 2026
